mentions.name: Mejl
mentions.description: A Gmail client in which every inbox view is built around Gmail labels. Users can paste exported Notion Mail auto-label instructions in as view descriptions.
mentions.problem: Notion Mail shut down, leaving its users without their label-based inbox setup; this client lets them import those exported auto-label instructions.
mentions.audience: Gmail users, especially former Notion Mail users
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a gmail client where every "inbox view" is build around gmail labels: https://mejl.cc

Notion Mail shut down this week, so if you used it you can paste your exported auto-label instructions in as view descriptions
